votes.motion: Council Member Robinson made a motion to accept and certify the results of the 2021 mayoral election which was seconded by Council Member Stroud. The vote was as follows: Robinson: yes Stroud: yes Nicholl: no Zoltanski: abstain Sharkey: no Houseman: no Christensen: yes

Council Chair Stroud made a motion to reconsider Council Member Sharkey's original motion. It was seconded by Council Member Christensen. The vote was as follows: Stroud: yes Christensen: yes Nicholl: yes Zoltanski: yes Sharkey: yes Houseman: yes Robinson: yes The motion to reconsider passed. A vote was taken again on Council Member Sharkey's motion: Council Member Sharkey made a motion which was seconded by Council Member Houseman to decline approval
